about: The Epistle of the formulary “Saints Peter and Paul, Apostles” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: In those days, King Herod laid hands on some members of the church to afflict them. And he killed John’s brother James with the sword. And when he saw that it was pleasing to the Jews, he went on to arrest Peter as well. Now it was during the days of Unleavened Bread. When he had arrested him, he sent him into prison, delivering him to four detachments of four soldiers to guard him, meaning to present him after the Passover to the people. Peter indeed was kept in prison. But prayer for him was being offered to God by the church without ceasing. Now when Herod was going to bring him out, that same night Peter was asleep between two soldiers, bound by two chains, and guards before the door were guarding the prison. And behold, there stood an angel of the Lord, and a light flashed in the room; and striking Peter’s side, he roused him, saying: Get up quickly. And the chains dropped from his hands. The angel then said to him: Fasten your belt, and tie your sandals on. And he did so. Then he told him: Wrap yourself in your garment, and follow me. And he went out and was following him, and he was unaware that what was happening through the angel was real, but he supposed he saw a vision. Then, passing the first guard and the second, they reached the iron gate leading to the city, which was opened for them of itself. And going out, they passed along one street, and at once the angel left him. And Peter, returning to himself, said: I know now for certain that the Lord sent His angel and rescued me from Herod’s hand and from every expectation of the Jewish people.
